clauses.actor_role: You (individual or entity using the Skills)
clauses.scope_note: Pigment grants a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable license to use, copy, modify, and distribute Pigment-provided Skills, including modified versions, only in connection with Pigment’s products, APIs, MCP servers, and related services. The grant does not state a separate permission for other uses or for sublicensing.
clauses.condition_explanation: The activities must be in connection with the Services, comply with the License, and occur while the License remains in effect. The license is non-transferable and revocable; termination conditions and consequences are stated at lines 42–44.

clauses.clause_label: 3. Restrictions — competitive model, dataset, product, or service use
clauses.scope_note: Prohibits using the Skills for the listed competitive purposes. The prohibition is purpose-limited; it does not state a general ban on model or dataset activity or on building products and services.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the Skills are used to develop, train, improve, or benchmark a model or dataset intended to compete with the Services, or to build or enhance a competing product or service providing substantially similar functionality.

clauses.scope_note: Prohibits removing or altering copyright, trademark, or attribution notices in the Skills.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when modifying the Skills by removing or altering any of the specified notices.

clauses.clause_label: 3. Restrictions — no representation of modified Skills as official or endorsed
clauses.scope_note: Prohibits representing modified Skills as official or endorsed by Pigment.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when making that representation; it does not prohibit modification itself.

clauses.scope_note: Distribution of Skills, including modified versions, is permitted only with a copy of the License and all applicable copyright, trademark, and attribution notices included in the original Skills retained. For modified versions, distribution additionally requires clearly indicating that changes were made and that the modifications are not endorsed by Pigment.
clauses.condition_explanation: All listed distribution conditions apply. The change-and-non-endorsement indication is an additional requirement only when the distributed Skills are modified.

clauses.scope_note: The License terminates automatically when You stop using the Services or breach the License. Upon termination, You must stop using the Skills and delete all copies in Your possession or control, including modified versions.
clauses.condition_explanation: Either stopping use of the Services or breaching the License triggers automatic termination and the stated cessation and deletion obligations.

clauses.scope_note: Requires use of the Skills to comply with applicable laws and regulations, including those related to data protection and export controls.
clauses.condition_explanation: The obligation applies when You use the Skills.

coverage_notes: The artifact in scope is Pigment-provided Skills: text files, prompts, instructions, examples, and accompanying materials intended for use with the Services. The Services are Pigment’s products, APIs, MCP servers, and related services; the grant is limited to use in connection with them.

No express permission to sublicense, charge, sell copies, offer paid access, provide a network service, or train models generally is stated. The competitive-purpose restriction is not a general training prohibition. No source-provision, copyleft, patent-retaliation, or licensee payment term appears in the supplied text.

The feedback grant at line 31 concerns rights Pigment receives in feedback, rather than use of the Skills; the supplied activity/object schema does not provide a suitable object for that feedback right, so it is not extracted as a Skills-use permission.

The no-trademark-rights and no-endorsement terms at lines 50–52 concern Pigment trademarks and branding, not the licensed Skills artifact. Warranty, liability, ownership, and governing-law provisions are omitted as not operative ASC terms for the listed activities.
